digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and Gerrit DET code-review criterion
propositions: Explicit review-plan on a bug with persisted non-test file_impact must escalate from light-advisory tier to full blocking rubric, with escalation applied uniformly across precheck det_blocking, route_criteria tier routing, and batch-runner fan-in.

Gerrit DET criterion must block bug-fix commits with non-test diffs exceeding 150 lines and lacking current valid attestation (cross-host op-cert verification via record principal's keyring), teaching remediation via fix-plan description and review-plan re-push.

Attestation verification in B2 must read cross-host via opcert_from_record, trusted_env_keyring keyed to record principal, and attest.opcert.verify_opcert followed by compute_validity freshness check; same-material op-certs from pinned foreign trusted environments must be accepted.

Non-test line classification rule applies universally: a diff line is test iff file path matches tests/** or conftest.py; all other files (src, scripts, workflows, docs) count as non-test; threshold is single shared constant BUGFIX_SIZE_THRESHOLD=150.

Verdict predicate must classify attestation states as ACCEPTED (certified, stale-code, stale-head), FLAG (remaining compute_validity plan-review-reachable literals and cross-host op-cert verification failures {mismatch, key_not_valid_at_era, unknown_kind, unknown_scheme, invalid}), or INFRA-FAIL-OPEN (unavailable, error, unknown-future).
Backtest over 113 historical bug-fix commits must flag exactly the 13 adjudicated-substantive commits exceeding 150 non-test lines with zero false positives from the remaining 100 mechanical changes.
